the implementation of ERM in construction companies is a complex process that requires changes in the organization’s structure, culture and processes, as well as in the mind-sets of the individuals in the organization.

the ERM implementation is a process in which the implementation team, the project owner, and the project team are the main actors and that the implementation process is influenced by the project’s context.
